content.title: Energy Fuels (TSX:EFR) Forecasts 70% Earnings Growth, Testing Premium Valuation Narrative
content.summary: Energy Fuels (TSX:EFR) remains unprofitable, with losses increasing at a rate of 12.2% per year over the last five years. However, forecasts are turning heads, with analysts projecting a steep 70.14% annual jump in earnings and 38.8% yearly growth in revenue. Both of these growth rates handily outpace the Canadian market average. Investors are eyeing these strong growth projections, balancing the premium price already baked into the stock with the prospect of a turnaround to profitability...

content.title: Comcast, Stellantis, rare earth stocks: Trending Tickers
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman and Yahoo Finance senior reporter Allie Canal track several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Comcast (CMCSA) issuing a warning on pressures surrounding its broadband subscribers, American automaker Stellantis (STLA) cautious on one-off costs for car companies, and rare earth metal stocks — Energy Fuels (UUUU), USA Rare Earth (USAR), and MP Materials (MP) — reacting to the details of the trade truce between the US and China.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
